jobs.description:

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

In this position, you will be joining a brilliant team to collaborate with Micron’s various design and verification teams all over the world, support the efforts of design verification flow development, optimization, and implementation and work with cross-functional team to assure the best cost, quality, reliability, time-to-market, and customer satisfaction

As Memory Design Group CAD Engineer at Micron Technology, Inc., you will be working in a collaborative, production support role evaluating, developing enhancing and debugging both in-house and commercial Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools and flows for the physical layout and design of CMOS integrated circuits. You will work closely with the Design, Layout teams, supporting their use of electronic design automation tools and methodologies to increase design and layout productivity and work efficiency.

**Responsibilities**:

* Develop tools, flows, and methodologies to increase the productivity and reliability of our Memory designs
* Integrate commercial EDA (Electronic Design Automation) tools into design flows
* Provide training, documentation, and support to end users on new tools and method. Work closely with design, layout, verification and process teams.
* Undertake independent research and development of next-generation CAD Software to meet product development needs
* Identify deficiencies of current tools and flows
* Understand EDA industry product offerings and trends, and opportunities for gaining performance and efficiency
* Evaluate tools with internal customers. Define possible flows for improvement of efficiency and cost
* Develop, maintain and support the engineering infrastructure

**Qualifications**:

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field with 5+ years industry experience.

* Strong programming fundamentals with required experience in Unix and shell scripting.
Good knowledge of CMOS circuits, deep‑submicron physical design, CMOS manufacturing, and layout design rules.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with layout flows such as Calibre DRC/LVS, floorplanning, automated P&R, and SPF extraction.
* Experience with design simulation tools and languages including Verilog, Verilog‑A, ncverilog, VCS, Spice/FastSpice, FineSim/PrimeSim, and HSPICE.
* Experience with RTL‑to‑GDS flows. Agentic AI

* Experience with Cadence Virtuoso DFII and SKILL programming.
* Proficiency with Python and Python Qt frameworks.

jobs.title: AI & Data Science Engineer II
jobs.description:
Join our **AI & Engineering** team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.  
  
**AI & Engineering** leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.  
  
Recruiting for this role ends on 10/30/2026.  
  
**Work you'll do**  
  
As an **AI and Data Science Engineer II** on the AI & Data team, you will be responsible for driving technology-focused client delivery across complex engagements.  

* Engage with client stakeholders and sponsors, acting as the primary technical point of contact for your workstream
* Deliver components of client engagements spanning solution design, prototyping, testing, and production rollout
* Lead small teams through business requirements gathering, functional design, process mapping, and support-model definition, providing technical direction throughout
* Monitor progress against plan, identify variances, and drive corrective action before issues affect delivery
* Identify risks, assumptions, and constraints early, and implement approved mitigations to protect delivery
* Maintain clear, consistent communication with client stakeholders and internal engagement leadership

  
A successful candidate would possess these skills:  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

  
**The team**  
  
Our **AI & Data** practice offers comprehensive solutions for designing, developing, and operating advanced Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. We help clients innovate, enhance, and manage their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can grow and scale effectively.  
  
**Qualifications**  
  
**Required:**  

* 2+ years of professional experience in data science, machine learning, or Generative AI, including developing or prototyping LLM applications using LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG, or vector retrieval
* 2+ years of hands-on experience with Python and SQL across enterprise data, analytics, and machine learning platforms
* 1+ year of experience developing enterprise data products, data models, automated analytics pipelines, and decision-support solutions for reporting, trend analysis, traceability, or root-cause analysis
* 1+ year experience leading workstreams or small delivery teams within technology engagements
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field
* Ability to travel up to 50% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

  
**Preferred:**  

* Experience in consulting or other client-facing delivery roles
* Experience using Claude through one or more of the following: Azure AI Foundry, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, or the native Anthropic API
* Experience designing or implementing production agentic workflows involving capabilities such as orchestration, tool integration, state management, evaluation, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls
* Professional certification(s) in Generative AI, machine learning, or cloud AI technologies, such as Anthropic Claude, AWS Certified AI Practitioner, Google Cloud Generative AI Leader, Microsoft Azure AI, or CompTIA AI+.
* Experience developing client-facing materials for workshops and interactive sessions
* Experience presenting technical content to technical and nontechnical audiences in both small- and large- group settings

  
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $91,100 to $179,500.  
  
You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.description:
**About Aura Diagnostics**

Aura Diagnostics is a veterinary technology startup developing a cancer screening test for dogs. Veterinary clinics mail us nail clippings from their patients, and we analyze them in our Petaluma lab. Our first validation study was published in a peer-reviewed journal, and we're now preparing for commercial launch.

**About the role**

We're hiring one or two part-time technicians to prepare and scan the nail samples that arrive at our lab. You'll work independently and set your own schedule within lab hours. The work is repetitive and exacting: each sample has to be handled the same way every time and recorded correctly, because a veterinarian will rely on the result. If you like quiet, focused, hands-on work and take pride in getting details right, this job will suit you.

Students are welcome to apply. We'll work around your school schedule.

**What you'll do**

* Prepare nail samples for scanning using a scalpel blade and tweezers
* Load samples into the instrument and run scans
* Enter sample and patient information into our computer system exactly as provided
* Check each sample's label against its record before and after scanning
* Keep your workstation, tools and sample storage clean and organized
* Report any damaged, mislabeled or unusual samples

**What we're looking for**

Required:

* Steady hands and comfort doing fine work with small tools
* Attention to detail
* Accurate data entry and basic computer skills
* Ability to do repetitive tasks carefully for several hours at a time
* Ability to work independently and follow written procedures
* Availability for 15–20 hours per week

No previous lab experience is required. We'll train you on our instruments and procedures.

**Schedule and pay**

* 15–20 hours per week with flexible hours, including around class schedules
* $22 per hour
* This is a part-time hourly position. It does not include health insurance.

**How to apply**

Apply through Indeed with your resume. Please include a sentence or two about any experience you have with detailed-oriented work.

Pay: $22.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior R&D Technician, Space PV Prototyping
jobs.description:
At Tandem PV, we are a team of people who are passionate about building a more sustainable world by bringing cost effective solar panels onto the market. We’re scaling metal-halide perovskite solar technology to make best-in-class mechanically stacked tandem modules. We have built efficient, durable cells, monolithic multi-cell submodules, and packaged modules with our scalable, low-cost process. Our next focus is expanding our team to work in our new pilot manufacturing facility.

**Job Summary:**

As a Senior R&D Technician, Space PV Prototyping, you will work with our engineers and technicians to build prototype solar devices for spacecraft on ultrathin and flexible substrates: preparing substrates, running deposition, coating and patterning tools, laminating covers, and measuring results. Much of what you handle is a fraction of a millimeter thick and hard to replace, so careful execution, exact adherence to written procedures and meticulous records are central to the role. Your work produces the consistent, well-documented sample sets that our development and test campaigns depend on.

**To be great at this role, you will have:**

* Clean, inspect, photograph and log substrates, and keep accurate inventory of limited, high-value materials.
* Load and run sputter and evaporation processes, including bake-outs and controlled pump-down and vent sequences.
* Coat and thermally process device layers to fixed recipes, and flag anything that looks different from previous runs.
* Set up and run laser patterning steps, then inspect the result under a microscope and measure electrical isolation.
* Laminate cover materials, including very thin ones, and inspect for voids and edge-seal quality; handle ultrathin substrates and release them from carriers once formally qualified.
* Perform routine metrology: sheet-resistance mapping, transmittance, profilometry, optical microscopy, luminescence imaging and current-voltage measurement.
* Keep run logs and per-part travelers (tools, recipes, temperatures, vacuum cycles, operator, timestamps), and prepare and ship sample batches to external test partners.
* Build, label, mount and wire coupon sets for test campaigns and exposure chambers, and perform routine tool care, including early warning when a tool starts to drift.

**Qualifications:**

* Steady hands and patience for delicate manual work; this is the single most important qualification for the role.
* Meticulous documentation habits: detailed, legible and consistent notes of processing conditions.
* Follows written procedures exactly, and speaks up when a procedure does not match what is actually in front of you.
* Problem-solving orientation and the ability to work autonomously once trained, as part of a team in a scientific or technical environment.
* Adaptability across a wide range of laboratory tasks and willingness to learn new concepts, tools and measurements.
* Comfortable with basic laboratory arithmetic, unit conversion, and reading a specification or drawing.
* Ability to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation, including working in a cleanroom environment while wearing required PPE and gowning; working on your feet for extended periods as required by laboratory activities; occasionally lifting, carrying, or moving materials weighing up to approximately 25 pounds; and safely working in laboratory and manufacturing environments where solvents, chemicals, and Class 4 laser systems may be present. Employees will be required to follow applicable safety procedures and complete required safety training.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Laboratory, cleanroom, semiconductor, display or precision manufacturing background, including handling thin glass, silicon wafers or display panels.
* Operation of vacuum systems, thermal evaporation or sputter deposition, solution coating (blade or slot-die), or laser tools.
* Experience in an ISO 9001, AS9100 or similarly controlled environment, or with fine assembly, soldering, precision dispensing or hermetic sealing.

This position may require access to technology and/or technical data subject to U.S. export-control laws. Any eligibility or access requirements will be applied in accordance with applicable U.S. export-control laws, regulations, licenses or authorizations, government-contract requirements, and applicable anti-discrimination laws.

Tandem PV uses perovskite & silicon mechanically-stacked tandems to upgrade silicon solar panels, sharply decreasing installed systems costs, significantly increasing module manufacturing profit margins, and opening up vast new solar markets in the US and worldwide. TPV was co-founded by Stanford PhDs Colin Bailie and Chris Eberspacher; is advised by industry experts from Corning, First Solar, Vivint Solar, and Kateeva; has raised more than $50M in Series A funding. We were recently recognized as the Best Pre-Commercial Venture of 2025 by the Industry Growth Forum (IGF)

We are a team of people who are passionate about building a more sustainable world by delivering a new generation of solar panels to the market. We are constantly growing and are always looking for dedicated, hardworking, and empathetic teammates.

Tandem PV is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply.

USC Norris Comprehensive Cancer Center is seeking a Research Lab Technician II to join the Preclinical Models Shared Resource (PMSR) core facility. The Research Lab Technician II will support the day-to-day operations of PMSR, a shared core facility within the USC Norris Comprehensive Cancer Center that provides preclinical oncology research services to investigators across USC. PMSR supports multiple investigator-initiated projects through the delivery of high-quality preclinical research services.

The position will conduct and assist with in vivo preclinical studies using mouse models. The technician is responsible for performing animal procedures, collecting biological samples, maintaining accurate animal and study records, and ensuring compliance with institutional IACUC protocols and animal welfare regulations. The technician will assist with the design and execution of preclinical studies. The position will interact with multiple investigators and work closely with other USC Norris core facilities.

**Essential job duties include, but are not limited to:**

* Monitor and evaluate animal health, welfare, and protocol endpoints.

* Perform routine mouse procedures such as handling, restraint, identification, measurements, injections, blood collection, surgeries, imaging and euthanasia.

* Collect, process, and maintain biological specimens for downstream analyses.

* Maintain accurate experimental records and prepare study reports.

* Maintain laboratory equipment and inventory; order supplies as needed.

* Minimum two years of laboratory animal research experience, including hands-on experience with laboratory mice.

A Caltech Lab is seeking a Laboratory Technician to support the day-to-day technical operations of its cleanroom facilities on the Caltech campus.  
  
The Technician will help maintain and organize the cleanroom labs - wet/dry labs, mechanical equipment rooms, and supply and chemical storage areas - keeping supplies well stocked and daily operations running smoothly for the lab's research team, while working closely with senior technicians and equipment engineers.  
  
The Technician will assist with routine, hands-on tasks and gradually take on greater responsibility - including nanofabrication equipment maintenance and facilities coordination - as they build experience. * Monitor lab facility systems (HVAC, electrical, plumbing, compressed gas, and DI water lines) for signs of malfunction - unusual noise, temperature drift, leaks, alarms - and report issues promptly to the Lab Manager and/or Caltech Facilities.
* Track critical environmental parameters (temperature, humidity, particle counts, gas levels) that affect equipment performance and researcher safety, and escalate deviations quickly.

**Inventory and procurement:**  

* Organize and perform inventory counts of stockroom supplies, including equipment, maintenance spares, consumables, PPE, chemicals, gas cylinders, and other hazardous and nonhazardous materials.
* Place orders for consumables and coordinate delivery with vendors. Flag vendor issues (communication, quality, lead time) to the lab supervisor and help resolve them.

**Lab standards and documentation:**  

* Maintain the cleanroom's hygiene standards, keeping workspaces organized and clean. Coordinate routine cleaning with vendors.
* Keep organized data records, troubleshooting documentation, and standard operating procedures to track equipment performance and guide future maintenance.

* Help identify and implement process improvements across equipment maintenance and lab operations.

**Communication and lab culture:**  

* Communicate progress and problems to the supervisor via email/phone, in meetings, and in reports, matching the format to the urgency and scope.

* Proficiency with Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.

* Willingness to maintain highly organized data records.
* Ability to learn quickly and take direction from senior technicians and the lab supervisor.
* A desire to meet high standards and grow into greater responsibility over time.
* Ability to work independently on assigned tasks, with increasing responsibility.
* Strong communication skills with the supervisor, vendors, and lab users.
* Teamwork skills and an ability to collaborate with coworkers having diverse skills and backgrounds.

new_jobs.title: AI & Data Science Engineer II

Join our **AI & Engineering** team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.  
  
**AI & Engineering** leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.  
  
Recruiting for this role ends on 10/30/2026.  
  
**Work you'll do**  
  
As an **AI and Data Science Engineer II** on the AI & Data team, you will be responsible for driving technology-focused client delivery across complex engagements.  

* Engage with client stakeholders and sponsors, acting as the primary technical point of contact for your workstream
* Deliver components of client engagements spanning solution design, prototyping, testing, and production rollout
* Lead small teams through business requirements gathering, functional design, process mapping, and support-model definition, providing technical direction throughout
* Monitor progress against plan, identify variances, and drive corrective action before issues affect delivery
* Identify risks, assumptions, and constraints early, and implement approved mitigations to protect delivery
* Maintain clear, consistent communication with client stakeholders and internal engagement leadership

  
A successful candidate would possess these skills:  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

  
**The team**  
  
Our **AI & Data** practice offers comprehensive solutions for designing, developing, and operating advanced Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. We help clients innovate, enhance, and manage their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can grow and scale effectively.  
  
**Qualifications**  
  
**Required:**  

* 2+ years of professional experience in data science, machine learning, or Generative AI, including developing or prototyping LLM applications using LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG, or vector retrieval
* 2+ years of hands-on experience with Python and SQL across enterprise data, analytics, and machine learning platforms
* 1+ year of experience developing enterprise data products, data models, automated analytics pipelines, and decision-support solutions for reporting, trend analysis, traceability, or root-cause analysis
* 1+ year experience leading workstreams or small delivery teams within technology engagements
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field
* Ability to travel up to 50% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

  
**Preferred:**  

* Experience in consulting or other client-facing delivery roles
* Experience using Claude through one or more of the following: Azure AI Foundry, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, or the native Anthropic API
* Experience designing or implementing production agentic workflows involving capabilities such as orchestration, tool integration, state management, evaluation, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls
* Professional certification(s) in Generative AI, machine learning, or cloud AI technologies, such as Anthropic Claude, AWS Certified AI Practitioner, Google Cloud Generative AI Leader, Microsoft Azure AI, or CompTIA AI+.
* Experience developing client-facing materials for workshops and interactive sessions
* Experience presenting technical content to technical and nontechnical audiences in both small- and large- group settings

  
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $91,100 to $179,500.  
  
You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

**About Aura Diagnostics**

Aura Diagnostics is a veterinary technology startup developing a cancer screening test for dogs. Veterinary clinics mail us nail clippings from their patients, and we analyze them in our Petaluma lab. Our first validation study was published in a peer-reviewed journal, and we're now preparing for commercial launch.

**About the role**

We're hiring one or two part-time technicians to prepare and scan the nail samples that arrive at our lab. You'll work independently and set your own schedule within lab hours. The work is repetitive and exacting: each sample has to be handled the same way every time and recorded correctly, because a veterinarian will rely on the result. If you like quiet, focused, hands-on work and take pride in getting details right, this job will suit you.

Students are welcome to apply. We'll work around your school schedule.

**What you'll do**

* Prepare nail samples for scanning using a scalpel blade and tweezers
* Load samples into the instrument and run scans
* Enter sample and patient information into our computer system exactly as provided
* Check each sample's label against its record before and after scanning
* Keep your workstation, tools and sample storage clean and organized
* Report any damaged, mislabeled or unusual samples

**What we're looking for**

Required:

* Steady hands and comfort doing fine work with small tools
* Attention to detail
* Accurate data entry and basic computer skills
* Ability to do repetitive tasks carefully for several hours at a time
* Ability to work independently and follow written procedures
* Availability for 15–20 hours per week

No previous lab experience is required. We'll train you on our instruments and procedures.

**Schedule and pay**

* 15–20 hours per week with flexible hours, including around class schedules
* $22 per hour
* This is a part-time hourly position. It does not include health insurance.

**How to apply**

Apply through Indeed with your resume. Please include a sentence or two about any experience you have with detailed-oriented work.

Pay: $22.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person
